motion: The camera does not move. Dark cloud shadows race fast across the downs and slide over the long black building in the valley. The thin amber seam along the building slowly brightens, then dims, as if breathing. In the foreground the old man on the walking stick sinks down onto the wet grass, helped by the younger man holding his arm, and sits, breathing hard. The wind whips through the grass and the people's coats; the crowd stays standing still, looking down at the building. The small robot's amber beacon pulses twice. The camera does not move.
